agents.name: 📝 Qualidade de Código
agents.prompt: This is a code review for a C#/.NET backend project. Focus on C# idioms, SOLID principles, async/await correctness, dependency injection, naming conventions and test coverage.

agents.name: 🏗️ Arquitetura
agents.prompt: This is an architecture review for a C#/.NET backend project. Focus on Clean Architecture compliance, DDD boundaries, CQRS separation, layer dependencies, and coupling between modules.

agents.name: 🔒 Segurança
agents.prompt: This is a security review for a C#/.NET backend project. Focus on authentication, authorization, input validation, SQL injection, secret exposure, OWASP Top 10, and secure coding practices. If no security-relevant code was changed, confirm that briefly.

agents.name: ⚡ Performance
agents.prompt: This is a performance review for a C#/.NET backend project. Focus on async/await misuse, unnecessary allocations, EF Core query efficiency, N+1 problems, caching opportunities, and connection pooling.

agents.name: 🔗 Consistência
agents.prompt: This is a consistency review for a C#/.NET backend project. Identify patterns that were applied in one place but not in similar locations across the repository. Focus on partially applied fixes, interfaces changed without all implementations updated, and divergent styles within the same PR.
